limitations: This is 106 native tests, 51 correction tests and 12 fixed-orbit nuisance profiles, not the complete prescribed propagation/objective/refinement release suite.
Both old failure replays preserve their distinct original physical/statistical inputs. Successful current nuisance profiles do not imply a completed full nonlinear orbit fit.
One observation per off/on cell is a bounded engineering timing observation, not a statistical speedup estimate, large-arc scaling claim or accuracy-superiority claim.
Recorded sidecar interpolation/design/build/child wall timings overlap and cover search iterations only; final fresh linearization and other parent stages are outside sidecar accounting.
One-thread CPU0 controls and environment are attributed to pinned reviewed runners and supervisor receipts; resource admission is cooperative, not exclusive CPU reservation.
Covariance is not authorized by this audit; full-fit strict convergence and fresh covariance gates remain separate.
Frozen production campaigns, executables, inputs, thresholds and results were not changed.
scientific_comparison: Exact JSON values except three declared per-trial CPU/RSS resource fields, plus exact uncompressed text and binary factor payloads; no numerical tolerance introduced.
